expanded_title: When Your Table Selection Is Off: Sitting Down With a Lineup of $5/$10 Crushers
expanded_deck: Walking into a $5/$10 session and realizing the lineup includes Wolfgang, Brad, Benji, Scott, and Amy — sometimes the best play at the table is recognizing a stacked lineup.
expanded_body:
Originally posted March 18, 2026.

My table selection was a little off this time — I sat down and looked around at a lineup of $5/$10 crushers: Wolfgang, Brad, Benji, Scott, and Amy.

Sometimes in cash-game poker, the sharpest read you can make happens before the cards are even in the air. As the clip on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1623841535321868/) captures, when every seat around you is occupied by a tough regular, you have to laugh and tell yourself: just choose another game, Sham.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
